model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of counts for different model types across various models. The x-axis is labeled “Model,” utilizing a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 110, with tick labels spaced approximately every 20 units. The y-axis is labeled “Count” and also employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick intervals of approximately 20. The first line, colored green, represents “Type1” and displays a series of bar heights starting at approximately 10 and reaching a peak of approximately 110. The second line, colored orange, signifies “Type2” and begins at approximately 10, increasing to a peak of approximately 110. The third line, colored red, denotes “Type3” and exhibits a starting value of approximately 10, rising to a peak of approximately 100. The fourth line, colored purple, represents “RR” and begins at approximately 10, attaining a value of approximately 20. Finally, the fifth line, colored teal, represents “WW” and starts at around 10, increasing to approximately 20.
